key_insight: RolloutPipe overlaps rollout and training in disaggregated on-policy RLVR by pipelining complete groups, reducing trainer idle time without sacrificing on-policy correctness.
engineering_relevance: It is useful for heterogeneous LLM post-training systems that need higher GPU utilization and lower end-to-end latency across separate rollout and training pools.
method: Complete-group pipelining (CGP): send each fully materialized trainable group to the trainer immediately in FIFO order.
Frontier-group dispatch (FGD): prioritize rollout admissions for frontier groups needed for the next batch so trainer-ready data arrives earlier.
Preserve on-policy behavior while overlapping stages instead of training on stale data.
evidence_signal: On Qwen3-1.7B across four reasoning/science benchmarks and twelve rollout settings, RolloutPipe reduced rollout-to-train-end time by 30.7%-42.3% and trainer waiting ratio by 37%-76% versus Slime.
watch_item: Benefits depend on careful dispatch and batching logic; implementing CGP/FGD in a real disaggregated system may add scheduling complexity and require stable group materialization timing.
paper_title: RolloutPipe: Overlapping Pipelined Rollout and Training in Disaggregated On-Policy LLM Reinforcement Learning
